# Historical QDN1 polygon payload charge

`record.qdn` was captured with the preserved candidate4 native runtime before
replacing it with consolidation bindings. The synthetic 16x16 RGB scene uses a
fractional polygon window, polygon tissue with a hole, a multipolygon exclusion,
and three rectangular Cells, calibrated at2 by0.5 micrometers/pixel.

`identity.json` records its original input/result hashes and capture/work charges.
The eager polygon text contributes exactly301 bytes to its7408-byte capture.
Lazy WKT must not prevent reading this historical record. Native tests require
byte-exact re-encoding and reject resealed byte/work charges changed by one.
The golden record and identities are original test data under the project license.
